author: Microsoft
description: Answer ALS and ALS Therapy Development Institute both work to improve the quality of life for people living with the neurodegenerative disease ALS. The nonprofits partnered with Microsoft to build a free, global, and secure database called Neuromine. Based on Microsoft Azure, the research hub houses trillions of data points provided by people living with ALS, now easily accessible by scientists across the globe. The hub is speeding research, bringing experts closer to treatments and a cure.
title: Answer ALS speeds progress toward treatments and cures through Microsoft Azure
